scope: Prepared schedule-record recovery in actual MarketingDesk and isolated ledger; fictional local QA

checks: Committed schedule with lost acknowledgement keeps its exact body, original times and locked snapshot through global refresh; keyboard replay adds no duplicate.
A latest-50 omission retains the pending card and identical replay until acknowledgement plus a fresh read.
403: a later retry rejection does not erase the original unknown save or unlock editing; eventual exact replay records one receipt.
429: a later retry rejection does not erase the original unknown save or unlock editing; eventual exact replay records one receipt.
Replaying the original schedule after a newer published observation preserves both receipts and displays the newer published state without downgrade.
A definitive first rejection permits correction, clears account/content and artwork attestations, and requires renewed checks before a fresh key.
A later reviewed version without artwork cannot replace the pending snapshot or ordered media hashes; a real stale-revision rejection preserves the exact uncertain request and locked attestations.
Acknowledged save plus failed GET offers Refresh saved schedule only; keyboard refresh releases the record without another POST.
A changed reviewed revision still resets an unsent schedule form and both attestations, without creating a schedule receipt.
scheduled first: same-turn schedule submit and editorial hold acquire one synchronous lock, dispatch one request and make one ledger decision.
held first: same-turn schedule submit and editorial hold acquire one synchronous lock, dispatch one request and make one ledger decision.
390px pending schedule remains visible after refresh with no horizontal overflow and a working keyboard retry.
No external page/server requests, real provider calls or browser exceptions.
held: committed lost acknowledgement retains exact request through global refresh, keyboard retry creates one event/receipt and preserves original observation
reviewed: committed lost acknowledgement retains exact request through global refresh, keyboard retry creates one event/receipt and preserves original observation
published: committed lost acknowledgement retains exact request through global refresh, keyboard retry creates one event/receipt and preserves original observation
uncertain: committed lost acknowledgement retains exact request through global refresh, keyboard retry creates one event/receipt and preserves original observation
Pending decision remains available when refreshed latest-50 results omit its brief, and exact replay creates no duplicate
403: rejection of a later retry does not clear the earlier uncertain request; eventual replay retains the same bytes and one receipt
429: rejection of a later retry does not clear the earlier uncertain request; eventual replay retains the same bytes and one receipt
Acknowledged write plus failed GET offers only refresh; refresh sends no second POST
Real self-review rejection unlocks editing and a new corrected decision key
Rapid double activation sends one in-flight request and one event
Acknowledged replay resets inputs from the latest receipt, preserves a concurrent newer observation and clears stale URL/outcome
Existing schedule save transitions to enabled delivery controls and a distinct observation receipt
A changed reviewed revision clears unsent schedule input and attestations without recording a schedule
390px pending decision has no horizontal overflow and the retry remains keyboard-focusable and operable
No external page/server requests or browser exceptions

retained_initial_failures.finding: Exact label-text selector included React textarea contents; original value survived refresh. Fixed harness to use exact accessible textbox name.
Chromium normalized :00 seconds and Playwright rejected the unnormalized input. Both harnesses omit trailing zero seconds without changing the intended instant.
